'''Kemon Kawamoto''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|河|かわ}}{{ruby|本|もと}}けもん}}''' ''Kawamoto Kemon'') is a Japanese {{wp|manga artist}}. He has worked on several [[Pokémon manga]].

==Works==
* {{ma|Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel}} (2016)
* [[Pokémon Sun Moon Z-Move Full Power 4Koma Illustrated Book]] (2017)<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20240129032205/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=0380902117 ''CoroCoro Comics'' February 2017 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kemonmon/status/820270681732497408 Kemon Kawamoto about Pokémon Sun Moon Z-Move Full Power 4Koma Illustrated Book on X (Twitter)]</ref><!--ポケモン　サン・ムーン　Ｚワザ全力４コマ図鑑-->
* [[Pocket Monsters the Movie: I Choose You! Remix]] (2017)
* [[Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us: Zeraora's Story]] (2018)
* [[Pocket Monsters Let's Go! Pikachu Let's Go! Eievui Adventure Start Comic]] (2018)
* [[Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu Exploration Team]] (2019-2022)
* [[Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master!]] (2020-2023)
* [[Pokémon Quiz Puzzle Land: Pikachu's Treasure Hunt]] (2023-present)
* [[Pokémon Frienda: Teach Me, Friender-Man!]] (2024-present)
